svg.text: Ansonia inside fit map, rev G (190 x 76 x 35.5, Dayton 70x30 speakers, 2 x USB-C), 1:1
Seen from the FRONT with the front wall lifted off. Top edge up, left end left. Numbers = BOM lines. Fit in the order A → B → C → D.
Not yet confirmed by the CAD fit check (the 190 rebuild is pending): dry-fit and tape, no glue.
LAYER A: on the lid (fit first)
cell, foam pad, insulator; 2 lid screws + inserts (X +37.5 top, X +45 bottom), 2 hook slots at the left end
lid hook slots in the spk L box
Dayton CE70-30P-8, face to the end wall
Dayton CE70-30P-8, face to the end wall
LTE flex on the top wall (RF) · cable → SIM board
TOP EDGE: buttons · LTE · 2 x USB-C
BOTTOM EDGE: pogo pads + dock magnets
A CELL LP1160100, 101 x 60.5 x 11.3 (max), on the lid
1 mm foam under, 0.2 insulator + 1.2 mm swell gap above. PCM end at +X. NTC + JST lead to the power board
LAYER B: board layer, Z 13.7 (fit second)
carrier on the bracket (H1/H2) + bosses (H3/H4); SIM, power and Qi driver boards; plug every cable now
lid hook slots in the spk L box
Dayton CE70-30P-8, face to the end wall
Dayton CE70-30P-8, face to the end wall
LTE flex on the top wall (RF) · cable → SIM board
TOP EDGE: buttons · LTE · 2 x USB-C
BOTTOM EDGE: pogo pads + dock magnets
B CARRIER 70 x 45 (will grow, see the PCB brief)
component side to the front, sits on the bracket (H1/H2) + bosses (H3/H4)
2 x USB-C · notch for the screw boss at X +37.5
NOT DRAWN YET: Bluetooth module 13 x 18, TAS5805M amp + TPS61088 boost, OLED 12 V boost.
They go on the carrier / power boards when the PCBs are laid out (see the PCB brief).
LAYER C: on the inside of the front wall (fit last, then close)
display, lens, Qi coil, Wi-Fi + GPS antennas, touch strip, mic + gesture board
lid hook slots in the spk L box
Dayton CE70-30P-8, face to the end wall
Dayton CE70-30P-8, face to the end wall
LTE flex on the top wall (RF) · cable → SIM board
TOP EDGE: buttons · LTE · 2 x USB-C
BOTTOM EDGE: pogo pads + dock magnets
glass to the lens, FPC tail at the BOTTOM edge → J11 · foam ring behind
left edge 0.3 mm from speaker L · dashed = window
foam side taped to the front wall · cable end LEFT
coax → U.FL on the module, bend radius ≥ 6
SIDE VIEW along the length, every part projected (FRONT up, back down), 1:1
B board layer: carrier, SIM, power, Qi driver
C front-wall layer: display, touch, mic + gesture
RF: antennas + GPS (keep metal, cells, cables off them)
D walls: speakers, buttons, pogo, magnets
